title: Great idea, but material is 20 years old!
text:
This is a great idea for kids who likes puzzles disguised as mysteries. Great for geography and logic, etc. My only complaint is that pictures and info in the book we got (Sweden), is over 20 years old. Aside from the pictures looking very old fashioned, so much has changed in the world that it's important to present much more timely data.

Nevertheless, we will try a few more months and see how it goes.
label: neutral
